# MyBreakeven

MyBreakeven is a free industry-specific break-even and feasibility calculator for small and medium businesses.

## Primary page
- [Free small business break-even calculator](https://mybreakeven.com/): Exact break-even revenue, sales volume, team capacity, required inquiries, scenarios and formula trace.

## Supported business models
- [Cleaning business break-even calculator](https://mybreakeven.com/calculators/cleaning-business-break-even-calculator/)
- [Landscaping break-even calculator](https://mybreakeven.com/calculators/landscaping-break-even-calculator/)
- [Photography business break-even calculator](https://mybreakeven.com/calculators/photography-business-break-even-calculator/)
- [Agency and freelancer break-even calculator](https://mybreakeven.com/calculators/agency-break-even-calculator/)
- [Mobile detailing break-even calculator](https://mybreakeven.com/calculators/mobile-detailing-break-even-calculator/)
- [E-commerce break-even calculator](https://mybreakeven.com/calculators/ecommerce-break-even-calculator/)
- [Restaurant break-even calculator](https://mybreakeven.com/calculators/restaurant-break-even-calculator/)
- [Salon break-even calculator](https://mybreakeven.com/calculators/salon-break-even-calculator/)

## Calculation policy
The deterministic formula engine calculates all financial values. Exact fractional results are retained; whole-unit targets are shown separately. Outputs are assumption-based planning estimates, not accounting, tax, legal or lending advice.
